import sys
from collections import deque

def solve():

    if a == [1, 1, 1, 1]:
        return

    visited = {}
    q = deque()
    q.append((tuple(a), []))
    visited[tuple(a)] = True

    while q:
        current, ops = q.popleft()
        if all(x == 1 for x in current):
            for op in ops:
                print(op)
            return

        for i in range(4):
            j = (i + 1) % 4
            if current[i] % 2 == 0 and current[j] % 2 == 0:
                new = list(current)
                new[i] //= 2
                new[j] //= 2
                new_tuple = tuple(new)
                if new_tuple not in visited:
                    visited[new_tuple] = True
                    q.append((new_tuple, ops + [f'/{i+1}']))

            new_tuple = tuple(new)

                visited[new_tuple] = True
                q.append((new_tuple, ops + [f'+{i+1}']))

    print(-1)
